title: Level 12 — Bash: Loops & Logic
subtitle: for, while, if, case, functions, test and $( ) — turning commands into scripts
description: One command does one thing. Bash's control flow does it a hundred times, or only when it should. Repeat work with `for` and `while`, decide with `if`/`test` and `case`, glue commands with `$( )`, and wrap your own with functions.
